storageDecision.body: Your data was found in more than one place. Pick the one Studio should use from now on — nothing is deleted, and you can move or remove the other copy later in Settings.

storageBlocked.body: You chose to save your learning data in the SQLite file, so Studio won’t touch browser storage. Start the local server, then retry.

welcome.title: Learn anything with a Socratic professor
welcome.body: Create a course, study generated lessons, practise with quizzes and flashcards, and ask a tutor that guides you instead of doing the work for you.
welcome.privacy: Everything stays on your device. Your API keys are never uploaded or included in backups.

storage.title: Where should your learning data be saved?
storage.body: You can change this later in Settings — Studio will offer to move your data for you.

ready.title: You are all set
ready.body: Create your first course, or explore the bundled demo course — it works with no provider at all.

tutor.desc: Socratic help for “{title}”. The tutor explains ideas and guides the exercise — it never does the work for you.

capstoneEmpty.description: The capstone is your solo build. Use this chat to think through a concept — not for hints, steps or code.

data.title: Backup & portability
data.subtitle: Your data is never uploaded. Backups contain courses, lessons and progress — never API keys.
data.moveRemote: Copy everything from this browser’s IndexedDB into the SQLite file, then keep or clear the browser copy.
data.moveLocal: Only available when the local server is running and its pairing token is set in Settings → My local agent.
data.exportCourseAfter: commands in Claude Code, OpenCode or Cursor.
data.backupExported: Backup exported ({n} records). API keys are never included.
data.noBrowserData: No browser data found to import.
data.importedVerified: Imported {n} records from the browser into SQLite — counts verified.
data.clearConfirm: Delete the browser (IndexedDB) copy? SQLite is unaffected.
data.cleared: Browser copy cleared. SQLite is unaffected.
data.exported: Exported {name} — continue it with professor:* commands.

storage.title: Where your learning data is saved
storage.subtitle: Studio writes only to the store you choose — it never mirrors data into the other one.
storage.sqlitePros: One file on disk, shared with the CLI — easy to back up and keep.
storage.browserPros: No setup, never leaves this device.
storage.browserCons: Cleared if you clear site data; may be evicted; not shared with the CLI.
storage.serverDown: The local server isn’t running — run
storage.movedMessage: Moved {count} {recordWord} to {target}. The old copy is kept until you remove it.
storage.switchedMessage: Switched to {target}. The old copy was left untouched.
storage.oldCopyThere: The old copy in {from} is still there.
storage.removeOldConfirm: Remove the old copy in {label}? This cannot be undone.
storage.moveUnavailable: The current store can’t be read right now, so nothing will be copied. Switching keeps your existing copy untouched — you can move it later once the local server is running.
storage.moveBody: Move {courses} {courseWord} and {cards} {cardWord} to {target}? The old copy stays until you remove it.
storage.secretsNote: API keys and settings are never moved.

workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.resetConfirm: Reset the workspace to the exercise skeleton? Your run history is kept, but current edits will be replaced.
workspace.invalidFileHint: Use a simple relative name like util.js — no slashes at the start or "..".
workspace.invalidOrDuplicateHint: Pick a unique relative name without "..".
workspace.deleteFileConfirm: Delete {path}? The run history is kept.
workspace.noRuns: No runs yet. Every Run and Check is saved here.
workspace.needsCommand: Needs the local server with `{command}` on your PATH.

errors.auth: Check the API key — it was rejected. Re-enter it in Settings.
errors.network: Could not reach the provider. Check your internet connection and try again.
errors.cors: The provider blocked the browser request (CORS). Try a different source or run the app locally with `npm run dev`.
errors.local_network_blocked: Your browser blocked access to a local server (Local Network Access). Allow the local-network permission prompt, or run Studio itself locally with `npm run dev`.
errors.rate_limit: The provider is rate limiting you. Wait a moment, or switch to a local source.
errors.billing: The provider rejected the request for billing reasons (out of credit or unpaid). Top up your account, or switch to a local source.
errors.refusal: The model declined to answer this request. Rephrase it, or try a different model.
errors.bad_json: The model did not return valid JSON. Try again, or use a larger model.
errors.not_running: The local server is not reachable. Start it and try again.
errors.server: The local agent failed while running. Check its terminal output, then try again.
errors.config: That AI source or agent is not supported. Pick a valid agent in Settings.
errors.model_not_found: That model is not available. Pick a model in Settings.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong talking to the provider.
